title: phrase_normalize — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins one input → expected-output case for protocol::phrase::normalize_user_phrase. Inputs and outputs are UTF-8 byte sequences hex-encoded (lowercase, no 0x prefix). The Rust reference implementation lives at protocol/src/phrase.rs (main myne repository); the pipeline contract is docs/spec/protocol.md §7.4.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'phrase_normalize/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped — downstream test runners may reference these strings.

input_utf8_hex.description: Lowercase hex (no 0x prefix) of the UTF-8 byte encoding of the input string. Even-length; the empty string is permitted to encode an empty input.

expected_output_utf8_hex.description: Lowercase hex (no 0x prefix) of the UTF-8 byte encoding of the expected normalized output. Even-length; the empty string encodes an empty output.
